authenticated_identity.rule: External identity may authenticate a subject, but final tenant membership, roles and permissions are resolved by Platform Core.

tenant_membership_roles_permissions.rule: tenant_id, membership status, roles and permissions used by product routes come only from the verified principal plus Core DB authority.

permission_scope.rule: Modules may map canonical scope dimensions to domain names but may not inspect raw permission assignments or invent unrestricted semantics.

locale.rule: Modules consume the shared locale set and direction contract instead of defining a competing language matrix.

notification_transport.rule: Product modules create governed notification intent; SMTP/push/provider transport is shared infrastructure and not embedded per module.

audit.rule: HTTP authority audit binds verified tenant/actor/request context in Core. Modules may emit domain events but must not create a competing platform audit sink.
